title: fix(console): a link refused as already linked to another user, or as unable to link, says why where the signed-in person lands
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XM9qtNRb2SHSriAQJ53cHoL)_ domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oG4qX4LXsVnuxP2PZ Fixes #33498 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:已登录用户关联第三方/OIDC 账号被服务端拒绝时,除了 #33063 已处理的「邮箱不一致」,还有两种拒绝:该第三方账号已关联到本系统的另一个用户(`account_already_linked_to_different_user`),或无法关联(`unable_to_link_account`,主要是不受信任的登录服务没有确认邮箱已验证)。这两种现在也走 #33063 的同一路径:用户落脚的页面弹出一条一直保留到关掉的错误提示,各有自己的句子,共 11 种语言(中文「该账号未关联：它已关联到本系统中的另一个用户…」「无法关联该账号。请确认它的邮箱地址已在该登录服务中完成验证…」)。 - 为什么改:之前这两种拒绝把人送回控制台首页,什么都不说;用户以为关联成功或者什么都没发生。 - 风险与回滚:只在 `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS` 里加两条映射和两个文案键;只带错误码,URL 里的文字(包括 `error_description`)一律不显示;提示里不出现其他用户或邮箱。服务端行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts` 第 133–145 行的两条文案与第 171–175 行的映射;`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts` 的两句中文。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.linkRefusalLanding-33063.test.tsx`,预期 12 个用例全绿(其中 #33498 新增 8 个)。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes **Measured live, through the real plugin-auth pipeline (`origin/main` a9da5474).** Both codes are produced on the signed-in link path and land on the Console login page. A throwaway probe on the `implicit-account-linking.test.ts` rig (a real `AuthManager` over the in-memory engine, a stubbed generic-OAuth provider, a real `POST /api/v1/auth/link-social` → `GET /api/v1/auth/callback/acme-idp` round trip with the signed-in cookie; not committed) read the callback's `Location`:
probe: four signed-in links, the 302 each answered ```text A links ext-shared (A's email): /after-sign-in (linked) the account row handed to user_b, A links it again: /_console/login?error=account_already_linked_to_different_user (A has 0 rows, user_b keeps 1) provider asserts email_verified: false (untrusted): /_console/login?error=unable_to_link_account (0 rows) operator config accountLinking.enabled: false: /_console/login?error=unable_to_link_account CONTROL provider email differs: /_console/login?error=email_does_not_match Test Files 1 passed · Tests 4 passed · VERDICT command-exit 0 ```
Read on the vendor code (better-auth 1.7.12 `oauth2/link-account.mjs`, `linkOAuthAccount`): the email check runs first, so `account_already_linked_to_different_user` is reached only when the provider account's email equals the signed-in account's (or `allowDifferentEmails` is on) and `findAccountByKey` answers a row owned by another user; `unable_to_link_account` is the untrusted-provider-and-unverified-email clause, `accountLinking.enabled === false`, or a failed `createAccount`. The callback (`api/routes/callback.mjs`) redirects both to `onAPIError.errorURL`, which plugin-auth sets to the Console login page, with no `error_description` (the failure carries no message). - **`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`**: two copies, `LINK_ALREADY_LINKED_TO_OTHER_USER` (`auth.login.errors.linkAlreadyLinkedToOtherUser`) and `LINK_UNABLE_TO_LINK` (`auth.login.errors.linkUnableToLink`), and two entries in `SIGNED_IN_LINK_REFUSALS`. The doc comment names each code's producer. Nothing else changes: #33496's `holdLinkRefusalForLanding`, `LinkRefusalNotice`, `LoginPage` and `App` carry them as they are. - **`@object-ui/i18n`**: the two keys in all eleven locales (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`). Each sentence says what happened and what to do, and names no other user or email. - **Changeset** `.changeset/33498-link-refusal-other-codes-notice.md`: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, both declaration lines. Not changed: the server, plugin-auth, better-auth. ## Tests `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/App.linkRefusalLanding-33063.test.tsx` gains a `#33498` block through the same two-leg real `App` (real `LoginPage` at the error URL, then `App` reopened where it sent the person, only `sessionStorage` surviving): - `account_already_linked_to_different_user` and `unable_to_link_account`, each under `en` and `zh-Hans`: the toast reads that code's locale row exactly. The URL also carries `error_description=bob@example.com already owns it`, and the page text never contains `bob@example.com`. - CONTROL: `email_does_not_match` under `en` and `zh-Hans` still reads its own sentence, through the same table. - CONTROL: `?error=email_not_found` (a vendor callback code that is not a link refusal) shows no notice and holds nothing. The existing `` control is unchanged. - The three sentences are distinct from one another in each language. **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`, anchor the two new map lines 1 → 0, blob `071313cfbfc3` → `21dc9edf96a5`; the console suite imports `src/`, no dist in the path):
Ablated: 4 failed | 8 passed (12); restored: blob == HEAD ```text × account_already_linked_to_different_user under en × account_already_linked_to_different_user under zh-Hans × unable_to_link_account under en × unable_to_link_account under zh-Hans Tests 4 failed | 8 passed (12) · VERDICT command-exit 1 ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (071313cfbfc3) and `git diff HEAD` is empty ``` Both `email_does_not_match` controls and the unknown-code control stay green with the entries gone.
## Acceptance notes - **Live, not only read.** The order allowed the vendor read; the plugin-auth rig was cheap, so both codes were driven through the real `link-social` → callback path. `account_already_linked_to_different_user` was staged by moving an existing account row to a second user in the store (the rig's posture refuses a second sign-up), which is the state the vendor branch reads. - **The sentences' "what to do".** For the already-linked case the way on is the Account app's Linked Accounts list (`sys_account` `unlink_account`, view `mine`), so the sentence says to sign in as the user it is linked to and unlink it there, or link a different account. For `unable_to_link_account` the common cause a person can act on is an unverified email at the sign-in service; the rest (linking turned off, a failed write) is the administrator's, which the sentence names last. ## Verification Head `06dc109b`. Local subset from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, reconciled with `--ran`:
38 derived, 38 run, all exit 0; --ran: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN ```text node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0 node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0 node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0 node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/pm/release-rehearsal-clone.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/ :: exit 0 pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:duration-unit-keys :: exit 0 pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests :: exit 0 pnpm check:closed-ceremony-text :: exit 0 pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs :: exit 0 pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary :: exit 0 pnpm check:driver-memory-census :: exit 0 pnpm check:engine-double-contract :: exit 0 pnpm check:gitlink-declared :: exit 0 pnpm check:merge-driver :: exit 0 pnpm check:nul-bytes :: exit 0 pnpm check:published-files :: exit 0 pnpm check:query-options-erasure :: exit 0 pnpm check:refd-timer-probe :: exit 0 pnpm check:registry-log-declared :: exit 0 pnpm check:rest-log-spy-declared :: exit 0 pnpm check:role-word :: exit 0 pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness :: exit 0 pnpm check:test-source-alias :: exit 0 pnpm check:tier-file-adoption :: exit 0 pnpm check:type-check-coverage :: exit 0 pnpm check:type-check-debt :: exit 0 pnpm check:undeclared-dep-imports :: exit 0 pnpm check:watch-hint-literal :: exit 0 pnpm check:where-matcher :: exit 0 ```
Also run locally on `06dc109b`: - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/ apps/console/src/__tests__/App.linkRefusalLanding-33063.test.tsx` → 35 files passed, 339 tests passed (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` → 102 files passed, 1894 passed | 13 skipped (the i18n census pins included). - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` after building the `@object-ui/console^...` closure → both `Done` (the console `tsconfig` includes `src`, so the new test is type-checked). - `eslint` on `ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`, the App test and `en.ts` → exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations` → 0 new.
